assets.name: The Walker: MakeHuman body, UAL skeleton, UAL2 zombie clips
assets.source: tools/walker/build_walker.py from MakeHuman (MPFB 2.0.18 basemesh, https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mpfb/), the official CC0 MakeHuman clothes toigo_fisherman_sweater (https://files2.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/shirts01/) and toigo_wool_pants (https://files2.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/pants01/), and Quaternius' Universal Animation Library 2 (https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2): its skeleton, mannequin skin weights and the Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop and Zombie_Idle_Loop clips
assets.licence: CC0 (MakeHuman exports and official assets; the clothes' .mhclo files state CC0; UAL2's OpenGameArt page and License.txt state CC0 1.0)
assets.notes: UAL2 is used from the OpenGameArt copy, captured 2026-01-24, before Quaternius' 2026-08-28 licence change. Animation, skeleton and weights only: no Quaternius mesh is in the glTF. Textures are not embedded; the game dresses the parts from enemies/walker/{skin,shirt,pants}

assets.name: Crate stacks (kitbash of Poly Haven Wooden Crate 02)

assets.name: Sandbag courses (kitbash of Poly Haven Cement Bag)
assets.notes: 3- and 5-course walls of cement_bag (1K glTF) decimated to ~165 triangles a bag and joined into one mesh by tools/props/kitbash.py. The sack's branded texture is dropped: its UVs are rebuilt as box-projected burlap and it wears materials/hessian_230 (Poly Haven, CC0), tinted khaki
